name: Eggless Cake Rusk

CONTAINS ADDED PERMITTED NATURAL & SYNTHETIC FOOD En COLOURS (140, 127 AND ADDED ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING Pro SUBSTANCE MIX FRUIT).
